units.source_text: 千重子一边回想这些往事，一边漫步在通往野野宫的小路上。

en.t: As Chieko recalled these past events, she strolled along the little path leading to Nonomiya.

units.source_text: 这条小路有块不太旧的路牌，上面写着“通往竹林深处”几个字。

en.t: On this path stood a not very old signpost, with the words "To the depths of the bamboo grove" written on it.

units.source_text: 原来比较幽暗的地方，如今明亮多了。

en.t: The place that had once been rather dim was now much brighter.

units.source_text: 门前的小卖店也扬起吆喝声。

en.t: The little shop by the gate was also raising its calls to customers.
